fallback_used: Same-process Next.js smoke server with HTTP fetch
validation_method.notes: Interactive browser automation was not available in this session. Validation focused on deterministic route selection, smoke rendering, and successful production build output.

checks.name: Europe corridor overlay expands the gateway pool when non-direct search is allowed
checks.evidence: travel-data.ts now separates Europe gateway expansion from Europe budget-corridor expansion, and planner-smoke explicitly verifies that both Hungary and Czech Republic appear in the gateway pool for a non-direct Europe search.

checks.name: Deterministic estimates can now surface budget-corridor shapes closer to market behavior
checks.evidence: planner-smoke now asserts that the Western Europe regression scenario resolves to an outbound FUK→LGW estimate and a return BUD→FUK estimate, both using higher-stop corridor pricing, while also asserting the expanded CZ corridor pool.

checks.name: Stay countries remain legible while return exits can move to cheaper gateways
checks.evidence: travel-planner.ts now applies direction-aware stay-country weighting so the outbound leg still prefers the selected stay countries, while the return leg is freer to exit from a cheaper corridor gateway such as Budapest.

checks.name: Two-ticket framing and internal-travel exclusion remain intact
checks.evidence: The app still returns separate outbound and return one-way recommendations, keeps Skyscanner handoff links, and preserves the between-ticket note that internal travel is excluded.

checks.name: The app still renders and builds after the estimator change
checks.evidence: npm run smoke and npm run build both passed after the corridor overlay refinement. smoke now runs through an isolated .next-smoke dist directory, so its dev artifacts no longer contaminate the production build output.

acceptance_criteria_results.criterion: A Europe search with non-direct routes allowed can expand to curated corridor gateways such as Hungary / Budapest and Czech Republic / Prague.
acceptance_criteria_results.evidence: The gateway expansion now includes both Hungary and Czech Republic when non-direct Europe search is allowed, and planner-smoke verifies that behavior.

acceptance_criteria_results.criterion: A flexible Japan to Western Europe search can surface a result shape closer to real market behavior, such as an outbound through London and a return from Budapest, instead of always preferring the nearest hub.
acceptance_criteria_results.evidence: The deterministic regression scenario now resolves to FUK→LGW on the outbound side and BUD→FUK on the return side.

acceptance_criteria_results.criterion: The app still frames the recommendation as two one-way tickets and keeps internal travel out of scope.
acceptance_criteria_results.evidence: The result folio still presents separate outbound and return one-way tickets, and the between-ticket note continues to state that internal travel is excluded.

acceptance_criteria_results.criterion: Typecheck, deterministic planner smoke, smoke render, and production build still pass after the estimator change.
acceptance_criteria_results.evidence: npm run typecheck, npm run test:planner, npm run smoke, and npm run build all passed in build/.

next_actions: Continue expanding the corridor overlay beyond Hungary and Czech Republic with a still-curated set of additional Europe gateways once more real-market evidence is gathered.
Add browser-based visual QA when automation is available so the planner preview and result folio can be verified end to end beyond smoke rendering.
Introduce live fare enrichment in Sprint 9 while preserving the current deterministic corridor model as the honest fallback.
